answeredQuestions.initiative-name: Proper Warm Retrofit Programme Demonstrator and Platform Assessment
answeredQuestions.business-context: Draft a product requirements document for a non-production retrofit programme demonstrator and platform comparison, derived from BRD-2026-AMA48-001 version 0.6.0.
answeredQuestions.option-set: Compare full Azure custom development, business apps (Power Apps, Dataverse, Power Automate, Copilot Studio and SharePoint; Dynamics 365 only if present), and an Azure control plane with M365 collaboration/documents and optional Copilot Studio channels.
answeredQuestions.owner-platform-preference: The owner prefers Azure for the AMA capstone and Solution Architect practice, but requested objective assessment of all options. This is not a customer platform decision.
answeredQuestions.role-profile-review: All eight company-* role profiles were asked for a role-specific challenge on 2026-10-03. Their responses are sector-informed hypotheses and unknowns, not company facts, resident evidence or approvals.
answeredQuestions.mvp-boundary: Proposed non-production, synthetic-data demonstrator; compare all options consistently and build only the candidate authorized at a platform decision gate. No production integrations, live resident contact or operational authority.

referencesProcessed.keyFindings: 60,000-home housing association case study; retrofit coordination, grant, resident consent, assessment and quality aspirations. Initial autonomy statements are superseded by later critical assessment and the BRD.
conflicts: Initial agent autonomy framing conflicts with later bounded-AI controls; the draft follows the current BRD and addendum.

referencesProcessed.keyFindings: Draft v0.6.0 describes non-production demonstrator, deterministic gates, human authority, synthetic or approved de-identified cases, portable evidence, failure controls and option appraisal. No signed BRD_TO_PRD_HANDOFF_V1 payload was located; BRD remains draft.
pendingActions: Validate against latest BRD quality report and approved handoff before PRD validation.

referencesProcessed.keyFindings: Compares Azure custom, business-platform-led and Azure-led hybrid; recommendation is conditional, with current systems, licences, APIs, operating skills and costs unknown.
integratedSections: Options presented to the Proper Warm role profiles

referencesProcessed.keyFindings: Used for company role and company-fact boundaries; platform estate details remain unknown.

referencesProcessed.file: company-* role-profile challenge (Asset Executive, Retrofit Programme Manager, Finance and Grants, Procurement and Contracts, Resident Engagement, Data and Performance, Building Safety, Neighbourhood Housing Officer)
referencesProcessed.keyFindings: Role-profile hypotheses converge on an evidence-first comparison: no justified platform winner; mixed is a candidate to test, business apps could win if existing estate fits; require whole-life cost, support, authority, accessibility, source-of-truth and failure-recovery evidence. No direct resident research or company evidence resulted.
integratedSections: Options presented to the Proper Warm role profiles
pendingActions: Validate role-profile hypotheses with actual company owners and residents where relevant.
